fact: UNDP states that in 2020, with Peacebuilding Fund support, it gave technical and financial support to develop a Mobile Data Collection App incorporated in the Gambia Police Force's digitalised case management system and trained 24 police officers to use the systems for data storage, analysis and real-time reporting of crimes, while justice and security sector case files remained paper based.
title: UNDP The Gambia 2019-2021 Report
